2610.13570.title: Constructing Pareto Frontiers of Optimal Reasoning Termination Methods for Overthinking in Reasoning Models
2610.13570.paper_summary: Reasoning models can benefit from test-time scaling, but continued reasoning may become ineffective or harmful, a phenomenon termed overthinking. Evaluations against full thinking compare accuracy and token usage but lack references for overthinking severity and strategies' theoretical mitigation potential. To characterize overthinking at the model-task level, we first introduce Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP), repeatedly generating answers from multiple retained prefixes along each fixed sampled reasoning trajectory. Using each trajectory's earliest measured position attaining maximum empirical accuracy as a reference, we define Overthinking Ratio and Accuracy Degradation as the fraction of thinking tokens generated afterward and the accuracy decrease from this reference to full thinking, respectively. Secondly, we then formulate dynamic routing, fixed budgets, and dynamic early exit within a unified framework to quantify the theoretical mitigation potential of different termination strategies. Based on this unified framework, we use the complete STP measurements to construct a token-accuracy Pareto frontier for each strategy under a common normalized thinking-token budget. We further develop OTBench, a reusable benchmark built from the STP process, which produced 70.5B reasoning tokens and the corresponding probing measurements across six models and four benchmark groups.
2610.13570.paper_summary_zh: 推理模型可以從測試時擴展中受益，但持續推理可能變得無效或有害，這種現象被稱為過度思考。對於完整思考的評估比較了準確性和標記使用，但缺乏對過度思考嚴重性和策略理論緩解潛力的參考。為了在模型-任務層面上表徵過度思考，我們首先介紹了逐步截斷探測（STP），通過沿著每個固定的取樣推理軌跡反覆生成來自多個保留前綴的答案。使用每條軌跡中最早測量的位置達到最大實證準確性作為參考，我們定義了過度思考比率和準確性下降，分別為隨後生成的思考標記的比例和從這一參考到完整思考的準確性下降。其次，我們在統一框架內制定動態路由、固定預算和動態提前退出，以量化不同終止策略的理論緩解潛力。基於這一統一框架，我們使用完整的 STP 測量來為每個策略在共同的標準化思考標記預算下構建標記-準確性帕累托邊界。我們進一步開發了 OTBench，一個基於 STP 過程的可重用基準，該過程產生了 70.5B 的推理標記及對應的探測測量，涵蓋六個模型和四個基準組。
